intro: Threat from Below is a defensive mission to purge aggressive naga scouts who are setting up camp nearby. By striking the scout forces and taking their spinefins, adventurers aim to drive the serpentine invaders back north and safeguard the area.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It wouldn't be the first time those snakes bothered us. They need to be taught that their presence is not tolerated here.
Find where their scouts are setting up camp and slaughter them. Bring me back their fins as proof. We need to act fast to make sure they understand.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hopefully those snake scum aren't giving you trouble?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hopefully that sends them packing back to the north. I'll have some grunts keep an eye out for any stragglers or funny business.
